content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Within 24 hours, you can have a fully operational online store that accepts crypto payments, delivers digital products instantly, and stores orders securely—all without a single server. Start by deploying a static site on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. These platforms are free and globally distributed, ensuring your store loads fast for customers anywhere. Next, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. With 300+ cryptocurrencies supported and a flat 0.5% fee, it’s the most accessible payment gateway for creators in Ghana. Finally, use Google Sheets or Supabase to store order data and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to deliver files. This stack is lightweight, cost-effective, and entirely within your control. No dependencies on platforms that can shut you down. No waiting for approval from payment processors. Just deploy, test, and start selling.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The core of your sovereign commerce stack is simplicity. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages handles hosting—free and infinitely scalable. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manages backend logic, processing orders and triggering file deliveries. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain, firing a webhook the moment a transaction confirms. Google Sheets or Supabase stores order data, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers your digital products. This stack is designed for speed and ownership. You don’t need a database administrator or DevOps expertise. Every component is free or low-cost, and you own the entire workflow after deployment. This isn’t a temporary fix—it’s a permanent solution built to withstand payment rejections, currency collapses, and financial isolation.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on what’s essential: getting your first transaction live. Skip custom domains, SSL certificates, and advanced analytics for now. These can be added later. Start with a basic store, one product, and a single payment method. Test the entire workflow manually before automating. Use BSC, Solana, or TRON for low-fee transactions—under $0.10 per payment. Avoid over-engineering. Your goal today is to prove the stack works. Once you’ve processed your first sale, optimize for scale. This approach saves time and resources, ensuring you’re not building features you don’t need. Infrastructure sovereignty starts with simplicity—own the basics before expanding.
Deploy your sovereign commerce stack today—no servers, no Stripe, no restrictions.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Deploy your store, load one product, and test the payment flow end-to-end. Use testnet cryptocurrencies to simulate transactions without risking real funds. Once verified, switch to mainnet and process a live sale. Document every step—this becomes your playbook for scaling. If you’re using NOWPayments, configure webhooks to trigger file deliveries automatically. Test with small transactions first, then increase the amount. This process should take less than 4 hours. By the end of the day, you’ll have a working commerce stack that bypasses Stripe, PayPal, and every geographic restriction they impose. This is how you take control of your revenue stream—not by waiting for permission, but by building infrastructure that works everywhere.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

Deploy your stack immediately. Start with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. Set up NOWPayments and integrate it with your store. Load one product and test the payment flow. Once confirmed, add more products and share your store with your audience. In 24 hours, you’ll have a fully functional commerce system that accepts crypto payments globally. This isn’t a theoretical solution—it’s a proven architecture built in Zimbabwe and pressure-tested against actual payment rejection and currency collapse. Your next step is clear: act now. Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose a hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both are free and globally distributed.
2. Set up NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Configure webhooks to trigger file deliveries.
3. Use Google Sheets or Supabase to store order data. Start with a simple spreadsheet.
4. Upload your digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant delivery.
5. Test the entire workflow manually: place an order, verify payment, and confirm file delivery.
6. Switch to mainnet and process your first live transaction.
7. Document every step—this becomes your playbook for scaling.
8. Share your store with your audience and start accepting payments globally.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The stack is designed for non-developers. Use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, NOWPayments for crypto processing, and Google Sheets for order storage. No coding required.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept?
Start with BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees—under $0.10 per payment. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, so you can add more later.
How do I deliver digital products automatically?
Configure NOWPayments webhooks to trigger file deliveries via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test with testnet cryptocurrencies before going live.
Is this stack secure?
Yes. Payments are verified on-chain, and file deliveries are direct. You own the entire workflow, so there’s no risk of platform shutdowns or data loss.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?
Absolutely. Start with one product and one payment method. Once verified, add more products, payment options, and advanced features like custom domains and analytics.
